title: Friedrich Nietzsche's view of Søren Kierkegaard — The Cold Version #Shorts
description:
Nobody designed the part of Friedrich Nietzsche's view of Søren Kierkegaard you experience — it was inherited. Since the dawn of the 20th century, the philosophy of Nietzsche has had great intellectual and political influence around the world. Nietzsche applied himself to such topics as morality, religion, epistemology, poetry, ontology, and social criticism.

Nihilism is not the conclusion of Friedrich Nietzsche's view of Søren Kierkegaard — it is the floor you stand on while examining it. The work consists of four separate books, entitled "European Nihilism", "Critique of the Highest Values Hitherto", "Principles of a New Evaluation", and "Discipline and Breeding". An English edition of Montinari & Colli's work is forthcoming (it has existed for decades in Italian, German and French).
